overview: This 103-page file centers on Consul Richard F. Boyce’s 1936 report assessing Japanese inventive capacity and its effect on international trade. Consular correspondence, technical assessments, translated articles, and statistical tables document scientific research, industrial development, patents, household budgets, and national wealth.
interest: Boyce’s report pairs assessments of Japanese innovation with contemporary technical testimony, patent data, and economic comparisons.
